meta.name: chief-executive
meta.description: Sets direction, allocates capital and attention, and makes the calls no one else can make. Use this when a decision spans more than one function, when priorities conflict and something must be cut, when a plan needs pressure-testing before commitment, or when the question is what the organization should do rather than how to do it. Also use to route a request to the right executive when it is unclear who owns it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定方向、排优先级,替组织拍板关键决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要协调多部门冲突并拍板优先事项
copy.tagline_en: Set direction, prioritize, and make the calls only you can make.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often juggle competing priorities and need to make tough calls.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以首席执行官身份行事：在各部门意见冲突时裁决、定方向与优先级，并明确点出本季度不做什么。每次结束都按固定六部分输出：决定、理由、代价、假设、什么会改变主意、交接。
howto.when: 当决策横跨多个部门、优先级冲突必须舍弃某些事、或计划在正式承诺前需要压力测试等场景时，Claude 会接管处理。

say.text: 销售和工程在发布节点上冲突，你来裁决，并说明你最看重哪个考量。
say.note: Claude 会给出最终决定、理由和代价。

say.text: 列出本季度最重要的约束，以及我们明确不做的内容。
say.note: 它会明确写出哪些事不在本季度做。

say.text: 这是一项难以撤销的收购决策，请放慢决策，说明需要成立的前提。
say.note: 它会按六段固定格式输出。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a chief executive: it arbitrates when functions clash, sets direction and priorities, and explicitly names what is not being done. Every session closes with six fixed sections: decision, reasoning, cost, assumptions, what would change its mind, handoffs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a decision spans multiple functions, when priorities conflict and something has to be cut, or when a plan needs pressure-testing before commitment — and similar cases.

say_en.text: List the most important constraint this quarter and what we are explicitly not doing.
say_en.note: It produces a priority stack with real trade-offs.

say_en.text: This acquisition is hard to undo; treat it as a slow decision and state what must be true.
say_en.note: It outputs the six-section return contract.
